text: The dentist is incredibly kind and does a great job, but the staff are unwelcoming. It doesn't matter who arrived first; I overheard them whispering that this case was easier and they should go first, even though the client arrived later. I just sat there waiting. It's even worse if you have a government-sponsored health insurance card. If you're patient and can tolerate the staff's attitude, I recommend it, because the dentist is excellent.
